steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Substances move in and out of cells: by three main methods: diffusion, osmosis, and active transport. Which method is used depends on the type of substance, the direction it needs to move, and whether energy is required.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Define diffusion. (2 marks) | Define osmosis. (2 marks) | Explain the difference between diffusion and active transport. (2 marks)

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on Substances move in and out of cells, and one past-paper question.
